- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 30
- Description: Me and @⁨Andrea - WEF Cacao shaman Falcon⁩ spent 30 minutes discussing how to put the batch out of cacao from Peru to Switzerland on our blockchain as well as how to integrate the funds from sales of these bags of cacao for Amazon reforestation via the infrastructure that we already have in place 
  
  Follow up
  - I send @⁨Andrea - WEF Cacao shaman Falcon⁩ Agroverse logo
  
  - ⁠@⁨Andrea - WEF Cacao shaman Falcon⁩ provides information about the farm
  
  - ⁠@⁨Andrea - WEF Cacao shaman Falcon⁩ provides information about the manufacturing partner in peru 
  
  - ⁠when bags are produced we issued QR codes for the bags 
  
  - ⁠when the bags are sold @⁨Andrea - WEF Cacao shaman Falcon⁩ will transfer USD$5 to me for tree planting on the land earmarked for restoration by Jedielcio in Para Brazil 
  
  *_Information to include*_
  
  - Google map location 
  - ⁠Videos of the facility
  - ⁠story of the people operating the facility
  
  Agroverse is be positioned not as a consumer brand but an initiative to restore 10,000 hectares of Amazon rainforest 
  
  _PS: meanwhile I will focus on driving around USA visiting the 7500 apothecaries to onboard them_

narrative.text: Andrea Catalina Falcon Rios De Pabst contributed to the TrueSight DAO across multiple projects including 20250617_beerhall, Recurring Tokenizations, TrueSight DAO itself, and telegram_chatlog. Her efforts primarily focused on human effort tracked at 100TDG per hour, with 12 such contributions, alongside injecting liquidity at 1TDG per USD for 4 instances and additional hourly efforts. She is currently a member of the Board of Governors. Active from February 12, 2025, to March 13, 2026.
